sentences.japanese: どうぞ、皆様も最後の一瞬まで粘り抜いてください。
sentences.english: Will everyone please stick with it to the last moment.

sentences.japanese: 彼は粘り強い精神の持ち主だ。
sentences.english: He has a spirit of tenacity.

sentences.japanese: 次には、これらのやの上に絹の糸をさらに張り、巣の中央に滑らかで、粘りのない部分を残す。
sentences.english: Then it draws more silky lines across these spokes, leaving a smooth, non-sticky patch in the middle of the web.

sentences.japanese: 最後まで粘り抜いてね。
トムはマラソン大会で最後まで粘るも、ライバルに敗れた。
sentences.english: Even though Tom stuck it out to the end of the marathon, he lost to his rival.
